Assemble RTF files from an assembly spec

Source: R/assemble_spec.R
assemble_from_spec.Rd

Runs assemble_rtf() with a Table of Contents built from an assembly spec (a data.frame from assemble_spec(), or the path to a saved .xlsx / .csv spec). Rows are ordered by the spec's order column when present.

Usage

assemble_from_spec(
  spec,
  output_file,
  toc_title = "Table of Contents",
  toc_leader = "dot",
  toc_page_numbering = "decimal",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

spec

An assembly-spec data.frame, or a path to a .xlsx / .csv spec file.

output_file

Path of the assembled .rtf to write.

toc_title, toc_leader, toc_page_numbering, overwrite, ...

Passed to assemble_rtf().

Value

Invisibly, output_file.

See also

assemble_spec(), assemble_folder(), assemble_rtf().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spec <- assemble_spec("output/tfl")          # review / edit the order
assemble_from_spec(spec, "deliverable.rtf", toc_title = "Table of Contents")
} # }
